as_told.title: JFK briefed on UFOs by Forrestal

plain: Harald Malmgren, an economist who advised several US presidents, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that John F. Kennedy knew all about UFOs long before he became president in 1961. In one version he says Kennedy learned of it in the 1940s through James Forrestal, a top Navy official of that era, and through naval intelligence. If true, it would mean the subject was known inside government circles years before Kennedy took office.
